method: Manual claim-to-source review against immutable arXiv v1 reports. Local arrays are fixed before readouts and independently checked by derivatives, matrix identities and bounded exhaustive scheduling.

supports: Canonical token IDs deterministically address multi-head hashed N-gram tables
Context-aware gating uses projected key/value and RMS-normalized key/query
The original module includes a short causal convolution
Training sharded lookup and inference host prefetching are distinct system paths
sources.localBoundary: Two scalar tables, two linear modular hashes, a 2-gram and a simplified sigmoid with hand-defined causal context. No tokenizer compression, multiplicative-XOR implementation, projections, RMSNorm, convolution, Transformer, All-to-All, FP8 or RDMA.

supports: The stated Engram variant omits the short causal convolution
The recipe applies head-wise Muon to Query and Key matrices
Engram tables, token embeddings and prediction head use momentum and alternating signed L2 balancing
Algorithm 1 has relative near-zero row masking, epsilon denominators, odd normalization count and final sqrt(n) scale; this update has no weight decay
sources.localBoundary: Exact polar directions are calculated only for the declared orthogonal-column matrices. The balanced update uses explicit teaching hyperparameters and small dense arrays, not asserted vendor defaults, sharding, convergence or quality. It is not the nonnegative row/column-sum projection used for mHC.

supports: DualPipe decomposes chunks into attention, dispatch, MLP and combine
Backward input-gradient and weight-gradient work is separated
The complete method includes bidirectional pipeline scheduling and compute/communication overlap
Parameter copies and activation costs have to be included in the reported system setting
sources.localBoundary: Only one independent forward/backward pair with two exclusive resources is modeled. The ten-node DAG, durations and two-bundle lifetimes are teaching assumptions. No full bidirectional schedule, PP transfers, SM partitioning, tensor bytes or hardware latency is reproduced.

distinctions.resolution: Preserve the original short convolution and the later explicitly stated omission/update choice as separate source versions.
The lookup example uses plain SGD; the independent matrix example shows a zero-current-gradient row moving due to prior momentum. Do not infer physical sparse-state allocation.
Signed rectangular L2 update balancing is distinct from nonnegative doubly stochastic residual mixing; do not reuse mHC spectral conclusions.
The complete source method and finite two-lane DAG are separately named. Numeric makespans are logical ticks and not vendor speedup claims.
